policy.exposure: one-sided certified site-boundary spans attributed to the object's own part segments; hidden = segment length - exposed (listed per segment)
policy.assignment: the room's wall trades under a rule requiring PHYSICAL_EXPOSURE (+ OWNER_PHYSICAL_AUTHORITY for a built obstacle) for the listed room classes; otherwise UNRESOLVED
policy.skirting: never created here (frozen contact path only)
never: a finish because an object is a column or duct
an obstacle finish without owner physical authority
an object face merged into WALL_FACE
a duct rule applied to a room class it does not cover

scope.applies_to: every Urban project: exposed interior duct / boxed-out faces where the surrounding DRY room treatment applies

method.principle: an exposed interior duct / boxed-out face takes the surrounding dry-room treatment
requires: OWNER_PHYSICAL_AUTHORITY (the duct is established as a built obstacle)
PHYSICAL_EXPOSURE (room-facing faces of the certified room only)
dry_area: SKIRTING (on the existing wall-contact path only)
method.height: the room's own authorised dry wall-finish height
method.physical_class: OBSTACLE / DUCT_FACE stays its own class; it is never merged into WALL_FACE

never: a finish on faces against existing walls, internal faces, non-room-facing faces or faces outside the measurement region
a finish for a generic obstacle without owner physical authority
a wet-room treatment by analogy (not stated)
new skirting where the contact path already covers the face

statement.text: the current exposed BED.ROOM duct (H2060 / H2061) receives SKIRTING, PLASTER and PAINT on its exposed room-facing faces

trades.PLASTER: exposed vertical faces at the dry 3.15 m height
trades.PAINT: exposed vertical faces at the dry 3.15 m height
trades.SKIRTING: unchanged: the existing V4 AUTHORISED_OBSTACLE_FACE path

statement.exposure: room-facing faces of the certified BED.ROOM site only

transfer_forbidden: any other region, plan or floor
any future project (the Urban rule governs there)

relations.why: the project statement the Urban rule generalises

physical_authority.received: R8.15 brief §1-§2 (owner reviewed the source-plan crop)

statement.text: the 2.10 x 0.40 m rectangle in the BED.ROOM is a REAL DUCT
statement.footprint: derived from source geometry (never a target value)
statement.material: NOT STATED (the role implies no material)

corroborating_presentation.role: a dashed X on a hidden layer - corroboration only, never a bound part, never a duct identity elsewhere

transfer_forbidden: the old Qortuba revision (QP-17 / QP-18 stay old-revision rules)
any other Qortuba revision, region or plan variant
any other entity of the same shape, layer or presentation

identity: every SEGMENT part of an entity with an obstacle state (OWNER_PHYSICAL_OBSTACLE = owner physical authority)
